core.evolution: Evolves into Wartortle starting at level 16; Wartortle evolves into Blastoise at level 36.

habitat: Scarce in the wild; found around small ponds and lakes, rivers in mountainous regions, and on secluded islands with members of its evolutionary line.
behavior: Withdraws into its shell when threatened and also sleeps inside the shell for protection.
social_structure: Has been shown living on secluded islands with other members of its evolutionary line.
activity_cycle: Sleeps with its head and limbs withdrawn into its shell.
physical_characteristics: Small light-blue turtle-like reptilian Pokémon with large colored eyes, three pointed digits on each hand and foot, a curled tail, and a hard shell.
The shell is brown above, pale yellow below, with a thick white ridge.
adaptations: Its shell hardens after birth and protects the body.
The rounded grooved shell reduces drag for fast swimming.
It can spray foamy water from its mouth with high accuracy.
reproduction_mating: Game breeding data places it in the Monster and Water 1 Egg Groups with a hatch time of 20 cycles.
parenting_young: The shell is soft at birth and then hardens into a resilient protective structure.
predators_threats: Sharpedo is identified as a natural predator.
defense_mechanisms: Retracts into its shell when threatened and can counterattack with water from its mouth.
hunting_foraging_style: Can shoot water at prey while in the water; no specific prey species are identified.
lifespan_life_cycle: Its shell forms and hardens after birth.
It evolves into Wartortle at level 16 and later into Blastoise at level 36.
